verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing docs confirm automated dunning core pieces — Smart Retries for failed payments, recovery analytics, and customizable customer communications/portal branding — which together enable a recovery sequence (doc5, doc6, doc25, doc24, doc13). However, the evidence never explicitly documents in-app banners, configurable grace periods, or final-state rules (cancel vs. mark-unpaid) as distinct configuration options. missing for 10: explicit documentation of in-app banner UI, grace-period settings, and cancel-vs-unpaid final-state configuration.
